name: funnypot/funnypot
description: Inverse of a nuclei scanner: detect scanner probes and optionally synthesize the response the template expects.

suggest.symfony/yaml: Required only to compile templates (bin/funnypot). Runtime needs PHP alone.
suggest.illuminate/support: Required only to use the Laravel bridge (Laravel\NucleiInverterServiceProvider).
suggest.psr/http-server-middleware: Required only to use the PSR-15 adapter (Http\InverterMiddleware).
suggest.psr/http-message: Required only to use the PSR-15 adapter (Http\PsrRequestMapper / Http\PsrResponseMapper).
suggest.psr/http-factory: Required only to use the PSR-15 adapter (response/stream factories passed to Http\InverterMiddleware).
